## Description

Trades the price difference between expiries of the same contract when it deviates from a modeled seasonal or carry-adjusted range.

## Where it may fit

Commodity seasonality, temporary supply-demand dislocations and futures curves with stable economic drivers.

## Vehicles

Commodity, energy, agricultural, rates and equity-index futures funds.

## Required data

Multiple expiry prices, contract specifications, roll calendars, carry/financing/storage inputs, seasonality and margin data.

## Caveats

Spread risk is not the same as outright price risk; use continuous-contract handling carefully and model roll, delivery and margin effects.
